description: Multi-hop retrieval across stored knowledge to answer complex questions.

prompts.input: What are the trade-offs between HNSW and IVF-PQ for vector search at 1M+ documents, based on what I've learned?
prompts.context_seed: User has memories about HNSW (O(log n) search, high memory), IVF-PQ (lower memory, approximate), and benchmarks showing HNSW wins on recall but IVF-PQ wins on memory at scale.

prompts.input: How does our RAG pipeline compare to what I read about Anthropic's contextual retrieval paper?
prompts.context_seed: User ingested notes about Anthropic's 2024 contextual retrieval paper (prepend document context to chunks) and TerranSoul implements this in contextualize.rs.

prompts.input: What patterns from the Hermes Agent architecture could improve our orchestrator?
prompts.context_seed: User studied Hermes Agent: YAML mcp_servers config, subagent delegation, trajectory compression, FTS5 session search, cron scheduling, tool-loop guardrails.

scoring_rubric.relevance: Does the answer draw from stored knowledge (not hallucinate new facts)?
scoring_rubric.accuracy: Are the retrieved facts correctly synthesized?
scoring_rubric.completeness: Does it cover multiple knowledge sources and connect them?
